title: CROSS APPLY — Top 2 Products per Category
description: Use CROSS APPLY to get the top 2 most expensive products in each category.

data.text: Write a query to return the top 2 most expensive products for each product category.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    c.CategoryName,
    p.ProductID,
    p.ProductName,
    p.Price
FROM Categories c
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 2 ProductID, ProductName, Price
    FROM Products
    WHERE CategoryID = c.CategoryID
    ORDER BY Price DESC
) p
ORDER BY c.CategoryName, p.Price DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: CROSS APPLY joins each row from the left table to the result of a table-valued expression on the right. The right side can reference columns from the left side (c.CategoryID). Use OUTER APPLY to include categories with no matching products (they return NULL rows).
